summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for collection-based data source creation in Flink, semantically separate from file-based sources, custom source functions, and socket sources represented in peer_candidates. No existing skill in the registry matches this capability. The peer_candidates are sibling skills in the same task_family (data_source_setup) but cover different source types (files, custom functions, sockets). The existing_skills registry contains unrelated domains (GRPO training, ProcessPoolExecutor). This is a new, non-overlapping capability.
